pageTitle: cyTell us if you need support
heading: cyTell us if you need support
paragraphs: cySome people need support to access information and use our services. We call this a reasonable adjustment. For example, step-free access to the court, documents in large print, or regular breaks during a hearing.
cyYou can ask for a reasonable adjustment at any time during your case by contacting the court.

cyYou must also contact the court to ask for something else, like communication in Welsh, a language interpreter, or special measures because you’re vulnerable. Use the find a court or tribunal service (opens in new tab) to get your local court’s contact details, or call 0300 123 7050, Monday to Friday, 8:30am to 5pm.
